common_issues.title: Moderation actions fail with a permissions error
common_issues.summary: The Ban, Kick, and Timeout operations on the Member resource need the bot to have the matching permission and to sit above the target member in the server's role hierarchy. When either check fails, Discord returns a Missing Permissions error
